name: What home restoration projects offer the best return on investment when selling my property?

mainEntity.name: What home restoration projects offer the best return on investment when selling my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Focus on updates that enhance curb appeal and functionality without over-personalizing. Kitchen and bathroom remodels, fresh paint, updated flooring, and minor repairs often yield the highest returns. Consider projects like refinishing hardwood floors or replacing outdated light fixtures. The goal is to make the home appealing to a broad range of potential buyers, rather than highly specific tastes. Essential repairs like roof maintenance or fixing plumbing issues are also critical to avoid buyer concerns during inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: High ROI projects include kitchen and bathroom remodels, fresh paint, updated flooring, and essential repairs. These improvements broaden buyer appeal.
